name: balances_unknown_fields_and_token_type
description: GetBalances reply with a field the client does not know at every nesting level and a token type it has never seen: the shape that broke Go on INT when validatord added currency.tokenInfo. Unknown values use only strings, booleans, arrays and objects so that every JSON library re-serializes them byte-identically.

name: stake_account_unknown_type_and_state
description: Stake account whose account type and Solana state are both values the client does not know, plus unknown fields on both objects.

name: mfs_entities_info_unknown_kind
description: Multi-factor signature entities info with an entity type the client does not know and one unknown field. All three required properties are present.

name: token_type_unknown_value
description: An enum value the client does not know decodes to the raw string, and is not one of the generated constants.

name: token_type_known_value
description: A known enum value still decodes to the generated constant itself.

name: mfs_entity_type_unknown_value
description: An unknown multi-factor signature entity type decodes to the raw string.

name: stake_account_type_known_value
description: A known stake account type still decodes to the generated constant itself.

name: mfs_get_info_unknown_kind
description: GetMultiFactorSignatureEntitiesInfo: an entity type the SDK does not know reaches the domain model as the raw wire string. It is never mapped to a known kind (the old TypeScript default was REQUEST) and never fails the call.

name: mfs_create_unknown_kind_sent_verbatim
description: CreateMultiFactorSignatureBatch: a caller-supplied entity type the SDK does not know is sent verbatim. There is no client-side rejection and no substitution.

name: asset_holders_unknown_type
description: QueryAssetAddressesV2: a caller-supplied address-type filter the SDK does not know is sent verbatim, and a holder row of an unknown type comes back unverified. Only INTERNAL and WHITELISTED rows are confirmed through a verified reader, so this reply needs no other call.
